name: clone-copies-only-the-root
why: the children are not cloned.

name: clone-is-empty
why: clone() returns an empty tree.

name: clone-mirrors-the-tree
why: left and right are swapped in the copy.

name: clone-uses-raw-new
why: new instead of make_unique.

name: contains-looks-on-the-wrong-side
why: contains goes right for smaller values.

edits.old: while (n && n->value != value) n = value < n->value ? n->left.get() : n->right.get();
edits.new: while (n && n->value != value) n = value < n->value ? n->right.get() : n->left.get();

name: contains-only-looks-at-the-root
why: contains gives up after the root.

name: erase-drops-the-left-subtree-of-a-node-without-a-right-child

name: erase-drops-the-right-subtree-of-a-node-without-a-left-child

name: erase-forgets-to-cut-out-the-replacement-node

name: erase-leaks-the-node-with-one-child
why: release() gives up ownership of the node without deleting it.

name: erase-looks-on-the-wrong-side
why: erase searches with left and right swapped.

name: erase-loses-the-subtree-of-the-replacement-node

name: erase-of-a-missing-value-returns-true

name: erase-takes-the-largest-of-the-right-subtree

name: height-of-an-empty-tree-is-minus-one
why: an empty tree has height -1.

edits.old: static int height_of(const Node* n) { return n ? 1 + std::max(height_of(n->left.get()), height_of(n->right.get())) : 0; }
edits.new: static int height_of(const Node* n) { return n ? 1 + std::max(height_of(n->left.get()), height_of(n->right.get())) : -1; }

name: height-only-follows-the-left-side
why: the right subtree is ignored.

edits.old: static int height_of(const Node* n) { return n ? 1 + std::max(height_of(n->left.get()), height_of(n->right.get())) : 0; }
edits.new: static int height_of(const Node* n) { return n ? 1 + height_of(n->left.get()) : 0; }

name: insert-allows-duplicates

name: insert-puts-smaller-values-on-the-right
why: left and right are swapped while walking down in insert.

name: insert-uses-raw-new
why: new instead of make_unique.

name: size-ignores-the-right-subtree

edits.new: static std::size_t count(const Node* n) { return n ? 1 + count(n->left.get()) : 0; }

name: to-vector-is-descending

name: to-vector-is-pre-order

name: tree-caches-its-size
